item.title: THE SOYANNIVERSARY, MORE INFO
item.description:
The Soyanniversary is a 7-day long event; every day will bring a new contest, competition or something else!
This is a discussion board for The Soyanniversary, i am the main host of the event, Mist. Ask ANYTHING you'd like about it. You VILL enjoy this event.

Questions I Thought (YOU) COULD Ask about The Event

Will all the contests / events end after the 20th?
Nope, some contests or competitions will still continue due to them being artistic in nature / other reasons. It will only be that on the 20th we will celebrate the 4th anniversary of the party' and also stop having events everyday.

Can i get to know more about The Upcoming Events?
Everyday full descriptions of the new events will be sent out and you will be able to ask about the events which were already fully released to the public, there are obviously the titles of these events on the main poster but there should still be some sort of mystery towards upcoming events, don't (You) think?

Will this be an Annual Event?
If soyteens will enjoy this little event and it won't be a total catastrophic fiasco The Soyanniversary MIGHT become an annual thing!

What are The Rewards?
There are MANY rewards, additions of your creations into a yet unreleased "Hall of Fame…" Something on Soyjak.Blog, A Cool Award for EVERYTEEN' to see on the sharty next to your name, a small legacy within the sharty as a winner of a contest of this grand event, possibly even 5 questions to Froot himself… EVEN having your own board! (Albeit it is moreso of a community effort. But whatever. (YOU) VILL see SQQN what i mean by that. Oh and of course i forgot, many Soygem Passes for those who have yet to get them! (And with that, access to the exclusive /gem/ board!)

For some contests and events, there are naturally different Rewards.

Anyhow ontop of that If you'd like a more personal place to contact me, you can also use the Soyjak.Blog PM Feature or use this thread on it.
https://soyjak.blog/index.php?threads/soyanniversary-general.6468/

item.description:
Hello. My name is Soyjak. I am a mockery of a stereotypical "numale". Over almost 7 long years you guys have made me and my friends a encyclopedia for us, a place in internet history, and a special little party just for us. We really want to thank you for keeping this party going for over half of our existence, and we hope we have repayed the favor. Our survival in the vastly changing internet landscape is a testament to how much some things just don't change.
<
We commend you, teens. And as always, keep on 'jakkin.

item.title: THE SOYANNIVERSARY : WIKI CONTEST
item.description:
The Soyjak.wiki Contest will last for 7 days, it will end on the 20th of this month, every edit that is considered a "Major Edit" will give you a point (So more than 500 characters in an edit), A new page that you created (with more than 2000 characters) / a page that you rewrote to fit more with The Soyjak Wiki's standards will get you 5 points.

Only SERIOUS edits will be counted in.

The contributors to the wiki with the most points will win and get some special rewards, which include :

A Soygem Pass
A Soyjak Blog "Competition Winner Award" Tag (Optional)
Temporary Award on The Sharty next to YOUR Name (Optional)
Of Course, a mention of you being THE WINNER on the wiki page of The Soyanniversary (Most fitting for the wiki of course!)
Some sort of mention that (YOU) were a winner of this competition on your user page.
And… Finally, 5 Questions to Froot.
